text:
sophie: Quick check-in — collecting vendor inputs for cost model Q3->Q4. Need per‑GPU hourly for reserved 1yr/3yr, typical spot discount ranges, observed preemption rates, any minimum commit or lead times, and region constraints. Also flag any SKU end-of-life risks. Planning to fold into the financial model by EOD Friday.

maria: Thanks — can you drop a tiny template we can send vendors and attach any email/CSV they already gave? @sophie

sophie: Yep — pasting a minimal template below to standardize responses (please keep numbers as USD/hour where applicable).
```
vendor: 
instance: a100-80gb
region: us-west-2
reserved_1yr_hour: 
reserved_3yr_hour: 
on_demand_hour: 
spot_median_hour: 
spot_95pct_hour: 
spot_preempt_rate_pct: 
min_commit_gpus: 
lead_time_days: 
sku_eol_note: 
other_terms: 
```
jordan: Add a column for expected sustained utilization (%%) and an approximate throughput number (tokens/sec at our inference config) so finance can convert to $/token. Also note whether reserved deals are convertible across regions.
simon: For modeling preemption impact we need historical preempt rates by region and by hour-of-day if vendors have it — spot discount alone doesn't capture reclaim spikes.
chris-lambda: quick vendor note: lambda can provide 6 months of preempt logs per region and a baseline spot discount range — older gen GPUs (V100, A100-40) show 65-80%% discounts; newest A100-80 often 60-70%%. Reserved 1yr ~12-18%% vs on‑demand, 3yr ~25-32%%. Minimum enterprise commit typically 20-50 gpus depending on SKU. lead times for bulk orders ~14-28 days.
maria: Good, can you attach the CSV here when you share? also call out any geographic restrictions (china, eu gov clouds, etc).
chris-lambda: will send CSV to sophie + maria today, flagging ap-southeast capacity is constrained for Q4 already.
sophie: Received — I'll ingest CSV and normalise columns to the template. Heads up: if spot preempt > 10%% in a region, we should mark it as untrusted for low‑latency SLOs and route to reserved in the model.
kyle: Does the committed pricing include replacement hardware SLA (RMA) or is that extra? If extra, we should add ops risk premium in TCO.
chris-lambda: for enterprise commits, basic RMA included; extended on‑site support is add‑on. I'll annotate CSV.
jordan: Reminder for cost modeling: include amortised reserved cost (capex‑like) vs spot volatility. Put an example row for A100-80: reserved_3yr_hour normalised across 24/7 vs expected utilization 60%%.
sophie: will produce a sample calc and post link to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE_LINK — please don't edit unless invited. i'll tag people when ready.
maria: timeline — consolidate inputs today, finance wants final assumptions by Friday afternoon, eng-ml review on Thursday morning. can we lock times?
sophie: scheduling a 30m sync Thu 10:30am PT. invite to follow. tagging @jordan @simon @chris-lambda. :thumbsup:
